endpoints.label: Top-level pathways for a species
endpoints.describes: Top-level pathway tree rooted at the species. species ∈ {Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, Danio rerio, ...} (uses scientific names). For catfish, fall back to Danio rerio (zebrafish) as the closest annotated teleost.

endpoints.label: Reactome pathway by stable id
endpoints.describes: All child events (sub-pathways + reactions) under a given pathway. stable_id is like 'R-HSA-1640170'.

endpoints.label: Enhanced query (resolve any Reactome identifier)
endpoints.describes: Resolves a Reactome stable id of any class (Event, PhysicalEntity, ReferenceEntity, …) into the full enriched record.

endpoints.label: Static interactor catalogue for a UniProt accession
endpoints.describes: Reactome's static interactor catalogue (IntAct sources) for a given UniProt protein. Lighter than the live PPI service.
